method: Independent fresh-context agents used frozen old/candidate skill snapshots on a black-box EXE task; an additional agent exercised the real web-button task. No fixture source provided, no Computer Use, only local test artifacts.

desktop_before.notes: Default 400-node inspection failed; 1200 succeeded with 619 nodes. Agent wrote its own scoped UIA actions script.

desktop_candidate.notes: Used provided within/window helpers; initial depth-2 inspection exceeded limit; first 20-second action budget expired. Logs retained returned actions. Agent closed initial app and used fresh process/output for verification.

web_candidate.notes: DOM click, click-correlated request, business code, status and actual file all checked; direct API did not replace the button.

limitations: One independent agent per version/task; the candidate desktop session included a restart. This is not a statistical study.
Model tool-call count did not improve in this sample.
Driver timings have different scopes; do not compute a before/after whole-task speedup from them.
A final worker-versus-journal consistency guard was added after candidate evaluation and verified in the full 37-test run.
